svg.desc: Activity calendar combining GitHub and Fornax Project and EXBO: 1,182 activity units in the last year. Activity units: GitHub: API contributions; Fornax Project: API contributions (UTC); EXBO: local commits (Europe/Moscow). Source counting rules and date boundaries may differ. Local sources report commits only; other metrics are not reported. Fornax Project: calendar activity only; other metrics are not reported.
